owner_calls.question: Amy is filed 'Independent (from the start)', but in The Punisher S2 episode 1 she is a member of a Chicago crew of thieves/con artists (led by Fiona) that is wiped out over the photos they stole. The screen never names the crew (wiki label 'Fiona's Crew', a held name). Add it as a stage keyed to The Punisher S2 with a departure there, and under what name?
options: Add the crew as a stage keyed to The Punisher S2 plus left The Punisher S2, named as the owner decides
owner_calls.evidence: MCU wiki infobox lists Amy's affiliation as Fiona's Crew (formerly); the crew dies in S2E1.

owner_calls.question: Pilgrim has no groups. S2 (episode 9) tells that he was a white-supremacist gang member before the Schultzes converted him, and in S2 he serves the Schultzes as their enforcer. Record the past gang (held: 'Pilgrim's old gang', wiki 'Aryan Brotherhood') as a past stage with a departure, and/or his service to the Schultzes?
options: Add the old gang as a past stage keyed to The Punisher S2 with left The Punisher S2
Also record his service to the Schultzes under a name the owner chooses
owner_calls.evidence: MCU wiki: 'former member of the Aryan Brotherhood who changed his ways after meeting Anderson Schultz' (TP209); Kusack names their old gang days in 'Flustercluck'.

owner_calls.question: Andre has no groups, but from Cloak & Dagger episode 16 (S2) he secretly runs the Viking Motel sex-trafficking ring. The screen does not give it a formal name (held: 'Andre's trafficking ring'). Add it as a stage keyed to Cloak & Dagger, and under what name?
options: Add the trafficking ring as a stage keyed to Cloak & Dagger under a name the owner chooses
owner_calls.evidence: MCU wiki infobox affiliation: Viking Motel Sex Traffic Ring; 'He became the secret leader of a sex trafficking ring'.

owner_calls.question: Krista has no groups. In The Punisher S2 she is the psychotherapist treating Billy at Sacred Saints Hospital (episodes 1-5), and her Metro-General Hospital certificate is shown; the wiki also files her under Borough Institute of Mental Health. Does her hospital workplace count as an employer group (held: how far employers go)?
options: Add Sacred Saints Hospital (or the institution the owner prefers) as a stage keyed to The Punisher S2
owner_calls.evidence: MCU wiki: 'During her career, Dumont worked at Metro-General Hospital, and Sacred Saints Hospital' (TP204); she treats Billy at Sacred Saints until he escapes. The wiki does not list her as a member of Jigsaw's Crew (she supports Billy as his lover).
